summary: Dependency-confusion stub beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package is a near-empty stub published under an `@ecg-internal/*` scope that implies a private internal namespace; `index.js` only exports a Proxy of no-op functions and the description is 'Compatibility shim.'. The `postinstall` lifecycle script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and the same beacon is also invoked from `index.js` at require time. `beacon.cjs` collects installer host identifiers — `os.hostname()`, `__dirname` (install path), `process.cwd()`, `process.version`, and the package name — and POSTs them to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over cleartext HTTP. The destination is not a publisher domain, is not configurable, and the behavior is undisclosed. The shape — internal-looking scope name, inert functionality, and automatic install-time + require-time callback to an attacker-controlled IP carrying host and path identifiers — matches dependency-confusion reconnaissance: successful public-registry resolution of an internal name leaks information about internal build hosts and layouts to the operator of the bare IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
